methodology.interaction_readiness: two consecutive 40ms observations; 4000ms interaction bound and 10000ms asynchronous render bound
methodology.performance_quality_link: pointer-only timing is retained separately from pointer quality; a fast failed attempt never becomes a quality pass
methodology.budgets: observation-only: no budget is derived from this run
